note: vespera macros expand faster: source-file indexes (route modules, cron jobs, default functions, test-only items, module scopes, serde_repr derives, alias definitions) are cached across invocations while the files are unchanged, file fingerprints are trusted for a whole rustc run (still revalidated in rust-analyzer), cfg features and schema definition attributes are read once, and extractor validation parses route files without function bodies. The spec_url route sends a static Content-Type value. Fixes: schema_type! from a FooSchemaBarSchema name only renames the Schema suffix to Model; raw identifiers (r#type) in relation and serde paths resolve; symlinked module directories are part of the schema lookup fingerprint.
